subject: Computer Networks
chapters: Chapter 6: Upper Layers and Network Design

questions.text: Define Computer Network. Compare the OSI 7-Layer Reference Model and TCP/IP 4-Layer Reference Model with their layer functionalities and design differences.
Explain Network Topologies (Bus, Star, Ring, Mesh, Hybrid). Differentiate between Client-Server and Peer-to-Peer (P2P) network architectures.
Explain networking devices: Repeater, Hub, Bridge, Switch, Router, and Gateway. Explain at which OSI layer each device operates.
Explain Transmission Media: Guided Media (Twisted Pair, Coaxial Cable, Fiber Optic Cable) vs Unguided Media (Radio waves, Microwaves, Infrared). Compare single-mode vs multi-mode optical fiber.
Explain Switching Techniques: Circuit Switching, Packet Switching (Datagram approach vs Virtual Circuit approach), and Message Switching.

Explain Multiplexing techniques: Frequency Division Multiplexing (FDM), Time Division Multiplexing (Synchronous vs Statistical TDM), and Wavelength Division Multiplexing (WDM). Explain data encoding schemes (Manchester, NRZ-I, 4B/5B).

Explain Data Link Layer Framing methods (Character count, Byte stuffing, Bit stuffing). Explain Error Detection using Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC). Given data word `1101011011` and generator polynomial $G(x) = x^4 + x + 1$, compute the transmitted codeword.
Explain Sliding Window Flow Control Protocols: Stop-and-Wait ARQ, Go-Back-N ARQ, and Selective Repeat ARQ with timing diagrams and window size constraints.
Explain Random Access Protocols: Pure ALOHA vs Slotted ALOHA (derive maximum throughput $S = G e^{-2G}$ and $S = G e^{-G}$), CSMA/CD (Ethernet IEEE 802.3), and CSMA/CA (Wireless LAN IEEE 802.11).
Explain Virtual LAN (VLAN) and its importance. Explain High-Level Data Link Control (HDLC) and Point-to-Point Protocol (PPP) frame formats.

Explain IPv4 Addressing, Classful vs Classless (CIDR) addressing, Subnetting (FLSM and VLSM), and Supernetting. Given IP network `192.168.10.0/24`, design 4 subnets with subnet masks, network IDs, broadcast IDs, and usable host ranges.
Explain Routing Algorithms: Distance Vector Routing (Bellman-Ford algorithm and Count-to-Infinity problem with solutions) vs Link State Routing (Dijkstra's Shortest Path First algorithm).
Compare Interior Gateway Protocols (RIP, OSPF, EIGRP) vs Exterior Gateway Protocol (BGP). Explain how OSPF divides an autonomous system into areas.
Explain Network Address Translation (NAT) and Private IP address ranges (RFC 1918). Explain Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) and Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP).
Explain IPv6 Addressing, IPv6 Header format, and transition strategies from IPv4 to IPv6 (Dual Stack, Tunneling, Header Translation).
Explain Congestion Control Mechanisms in Network Layer: Leaky Bucket Algorithm vs Token Bucket Algorithm for traffic shaping.
Differentiate between TCP and UDP in terms of connection management, reliability, header overhead, flow control, and application use cases.
Explain TCP 3-Way Handshake connection establishment, 4-Way connection release, and TCP Segment Header structure.
Explain TCP Congestion Control Mechanisms: Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance (Additive Increase Multiplicative Decrease - AIMD), Fast Retransmit, and Fast Recovery.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Upper Layers and Network Design
questions.text: Explain Domain Name System (DNS): Hierarchical namespace, Recursive vs Iterative DNS resolution queries, and DNS Resource Records (A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, PTR).

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Upper Layers and Network Design
questions.text: Explain Application Layer Protocols: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP DORA process), HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, and Email Protocols (SMTP, POP3, IMAP).

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Upper Layers and Network Design
questions.text: Explain Network Management protocol: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) architecture (Manager, Agent, MIB, Trap). Explain VoIP and IP interconnection basics.
Explain Software-Defined Networking (SDN): Architecture (Control Plane vs Data Plane separation, OpenFlow protocol), importance, and applications.
Explain Content Delivery Networks (CDNs), Network Virtualization, and recent trends in Computer Networking (Named Data Networking, Quantum Networking).
Explain Network Security essentials: Symmetric vs Asymmetric cryptography, Firewalls (Packet filtering vs Stateful), and IPsec protocol (AH and ESP modes).
